senses.sense_definition: A person who has an obsessive desire for power or feels they are much more important or powerful than they actually are.

examples.text: The dictator was a dangerous <w>megalomaniac</w> who believed he could conquer the entire world.
Many people considered the CEO a <w>megalomaniac</w> because he demanded total control over every minor decision.

senses.sense_definition: Relating to or characterized by an obsessive desire for power or an inflated sense of one's own importance.

examples.text: His <w>megalomaniac</w> ambitions eventually led to the total collapse of his political career.
The company culture suffered under the <w>megalomaniac</w> leadership of its founder.
